summary.text: Huldah Hiltsley is a Democratic state representative from Minnesota House District 38A who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Her career has been in data privacy and data protection.

paragraphs.text: Huldah Hiltsley graduated from Cooper High School and earned three bachelor's degrees and an MBA from Bethel University.
Her career experience includes working in the fields of data privacy and data protection.
Hiltsley assumed office on January 14, 2025, succeeding Michael Nelson, and her current term ends on January 12, 2027.
In the 2025-2026 session she was assigned to the Housing Finance and Policy, Human Services Finance and Policy, and Legacy Finance committees.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026.
